original_test_intent: Exercise every front-side storage bay for 12 hours at 40C and +5% 5V/3.3V rail margin and detect storage or platform instability.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Select front-side disks in SST and stress for 12 hours after configuration and log preparation.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: The source repeats setup steps and supplies no technical acceptance threshold.

historical_reviews.v3: RECLASSIFIED to MANUAL ONLY; correctly gated undefined I/O but marked 12 hours versus 240-minute Machine Time as SOURCE_CONFLICT.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator controls the chamber, rail margin and storage setup; a qualified workload may run automatically only after target interlocks.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 40C, +5% rails, every front-side bay, 12-hour SST stress; 240-minute Machine Time is planning metadata.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Bay map, stable identities, ownership, safe workload, integrity and acceptance limits, fixture tolerances and approved override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: A shorter duration, bay subset or different workload must be recorded against the Master requirement.

original_method: Original SST storage procedure is retained as the Master method.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the approved project storage stress harness only after persistent bay-to-device mapping and protected-use checks.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Project storage topology at qualified environmental margin.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project SST/tool manual and platform storage SOP; no public replacement is asserted.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds target identity, data ownership and evidence controls without replacing SST.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Must still cover every required front bay for the approved duration.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Tool version/profile, bay map and integrity thresholds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-device writes can destroy OS or evidence data.

safety_boundaries: No I/O to OS, mounted/in-use, RAID-member, data, evidence or unidentified devices
No log clearing or unapproved destructive mode
expected_evidence: Physical bay and persistent device mapping
no_automatic_retry: A failed I/O cycle is preserved; no extra run is added.
engineer_owned_verdict: Storage/margin engineer decides whether evidence satisfies the approved plan.
review_improvement: Removes the planning-time false conflict while keeping the 12-hour Master requirement, the missing acceptance issue and strict storage protection.
